about_the_game:
Dopaminer lets you poke your brain to mine dopamine. Click the floating Synapse bits to earn DP, invest that DP in strategic upgrades, automate your Dopamining and use Rewire to increase efficiency with each run.

Increase your Effective Score to unlock higher tiers where new mechanics become available. Encounter rare dopamine bits that provide larger payouts. Automation features allow steady progression whether you are actively clicking or letting it play for you while you’re away. Play Daily Challenges and earn Cortexium (CX) to buy upgrades in the shop.  

Key Features

Click Synapses. Upgrade. Automate. Rewire. Easy to learn, hard to stop. Numbers go brrr.

Four Upgrade Tabs

  • Core: Increase Synapse value, spawn speed, lifetime, and chain reactions.

  • Automation: Start Auto-Collecting, enable Magnet Bursts to gather bits, place Pulse nodes and Overclock those upgrades!

  • Rarity: Increase the spawning of valuable Synapse bits and increase multipliers on them.

  • Meta: Spend Synapse Points on permanent perks that will increase efficiency on each run. 

Tier Progression

Achieve key score milestones to unlock new automation and expanded upgrade options. 

Rewire

Use Rewire to reset your run while retaining Synapse Points, boosting future runs through permanent meta-upgrades Future Dopamine flows faster. 

Daily Challenges

These short skill-based tests pause the idle grind for pure action. Rack up CX to supercharge your Dopamining. 

  • Cognitive Echo: Memorize flashing tile patterns, and repeat the pattern.. 

  • Corruption Defense: Click incoming corrupted Synapse bits before they hit the core of your brain.

  • Falling Bits: Target one rarity Synapse only and survive.  

Offline Progress

Leave it running. Return to piles of dopamine waiting for you.

Steam Achievements

Many to be mined! Get even more real life dopamine by achieving all the achievements! 

Your brain factory awaits. Click that first synapse. Then the next. Automate it all. Dopamine real dopamine!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or Intel 64-bit (Core i3+)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (Intel HD 4000/Iris or better, AMD Radeon HD 7000+, Apple M1 GPU)
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Internet only required for Steam features (Cloud/Achievements/Overlay). Offline play supported.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i5+
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM (Apple M1/M2 GPU, Intel Iris Plus, or discrete AMD)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs natively on Apple Silicon. 64-bit only.

name: Dopaminer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent (64-bit)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11–capable GPU (Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GTX 600 / AMD HD 7000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit OS required. Internet only needed for Steam features (Cloud/Achievements/Overlay). Offline play supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 (64-bit)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11–capable GPU with 1 GB+ VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 460 / Intel Iris Plus or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Windowed or fullscreen. Runs on laptops and desktops; no special peripherals required.

short_description: Dopaminer lets you do the most scientifically accurate thing possible: click Synapse bits that reward you with Dopamine. Upgrade your neural rig by stacking upgrades, unlock new tiers, automate progress, and Rewire to prestige. Spend Synapse Points for permanent perks and watch each run accelerate.
